texts.zh:
一个规模庞大的老兵代表团致信，要求离开当地前往位于[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的殖民地——此地也是我们的附庸[subject_empire.GetName]的首都。随信件附上的还有一笔礼金，用于“使官僚的齿轮运转更为润滑”，他们这样委婉地表述道。

似乎在我们的老兵中间流传着许多这样的故事，讲述一个人前往这些恒星系是如何在冒险中发了大财——或是作为雇佣兵，或是作为海盗。无论是哪一种，很显然这些老兵掏出了自己的家底进行众筹，希望能够通过前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]赚他个几番。

如果我们决定以官方名义派遣他们去往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]，他们至少更可能对当地的领导阶级起到良性的促进作用——并且更有可能尊重我们附庸的法律和条例——相比于让他们自己跑过去来说。
texts.en:
A large contingent of our veterans has sent a letter requesting leave to travel to the colony at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of our vassal [subject_empire.GetName]. Included with the letter is a gift of credits to "grease the wheels of bureaucracy", as they so delicately put it.

It seems there are quite a lot of stories among some of our soldiers about the lucrative adventures one can find in those systems - be it as a mercenary or a pirate. In either case, it is made clear that they have put together what credits they have, hoping to make many times that if they are sent off to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName].

If we were to formally send them to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] they are at least more likely to be a boon to the leadership there - and more likely to respect the laws and rules of our vassal - than if we were to let them run free.

label.zh: 以官方名义发函允许他们前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]。
label.en: Give them formal leave to travel to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 老兵们会被送往[subject_empire.GetName]进行援建。
tooltips.en: The veterans will be sent to aid [subject_empire.GetName].

label.zh: 他们想做什么就做什么。
label.en: Let them do as they wish.

tooltips.en: The veterans might cause havoc in [subject_empire.GetName].

label.zh: 我们不会被这群想当海盗的家伙贿赂。
label.en: We will not be bribed by these would-be privateers.

tooltips.zh: 这批老兵不允许离开我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: The veterans will not be allowed to leave our empire.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国首都所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire's capital world appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现相关帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the empire's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们接收了一伙来自我们的宗主国[overlord_empire.GetName]的老兵。看上去是[overlord.Ruler.GetRegnalName]正式派遣他们过来对我们进行援建，并且同我们的部队分享他们的知识和经验——至少他们是这么宣称的。

然而，自打一开始，这些士兵就很明显地发现了，他们所看到的和他们所设想的完全不一样。团体内部的抱怨和不满之情也传到了我们耳里。看样子，他们坚信自己能在当地找到财宝，或者能干上海盗的行当从我们手里偷走东西。

如果我们计划让这群老兵留在当地，我们可得小心不能把他们看得太松了。
texts.en:
We have received a group of veterans from our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName]. It seems they have formally been sent here by [overlord.Ruler.GetRegnalName] to aid us, and to share their experience and knowledge with our troops - or so they claim.

From the get-go, it is made clear that these soldiers envisioned a different environment to the one they have found. Mumbling and grumbling among their contingent has made its way back to us. It seems they believed they would find riches, or else become pirates to steal from us.

If we are going to let these veterans stay, we should make sure to keep them on a short leash.

label.en: Put their experience to good use.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现宗主帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the overlord empire appears here.

texts.zh: 尽管我们对于派遣那群渴望冒险的老兵去往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]一事有所保留，我们却收到了附庸的报告，称那群老兵已经将当地视为自己的家园，发挥的作用比预料的要多得多。
texts.en: Though we had our reservations about sending the adventure-seeking veterans to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], we have received reports from our vassal that they have found themselves at home there, and have proven to be more helpful than one would originally expect.

label.zh: 看来我们白担心了一场。
label.en: It seems our worries were misplaced.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国首都所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire's capital world appears here.

texts.zh: 在[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]作短暂停留之后，我们的老兵被送回了[Root.Capital.GetName]的家。显然他们只是证明了自己是一团麻烦，在我们属国的人民中间酿成了祸。
texts.en: After a short stay at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], our veterans have been sent home to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Apparently they only proved to be trouble, and caused some havoc among our subject population.

label.zh: 到头来，就跟我们预料的一样。
label.en: So it turned out as expected, after all.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国首都所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire's capital world appears here.

texts.zh: 我们最初的担忧恰如其分。在到达[subject_empire.GetName]不久之后，我们的老兵马上转行当了海盗。如果不出意外，这些离经叛道的行径是追查不到我们的头上的。
texts.en: Our initial worries seem to have been well-placed. Shortly after getting to [subject_empire.GetName] our old soldiers seem to have embraced piracy. If nothing else, this betrayal does not seem to have been traced back to us yet.

label.zh: 我们希望事情就照这样发展。
label.en: Let us hope it stays that way.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现相关帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the empire's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]星系的贸易路线没有得到很好的保护，现在近乎变成了法外之地。该恒星系已经吸引了越来越多的海盗、走私贩以及其它各种不法分子，肆无忌惮地掠夺我们的货物。
texts.en: Our trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system is poorly protected and passes through what has largely become lawless space. An increasing number of pirates, smugglers and various other criminal elements have been drawn to the system, and they now raid our shipping with near impunity.

texts.zh: 途经[pirate_system.GetName]星系的无防备贸易路线已经引起了一群海盗们的注意。这些匪徒集结了一支大舰队，拦截了该恒星系的大部分贸易。
texts.en: The unprotected trade route that passes through the [pirate_system.GetName] system has attracted the attention of a roving band of pirates. These outlaws have gathered a sizeable fleet that is intercepting much of the system's trade.

texts.zh: 因其贸易路线毫无防备，[pirate_system.GetName]星系已经吸引了大批不法分子，并且在最近的一次权力争夺之后，这些犯罪分子们已经有了足够的组织性，组成了一支大海盗舰队。他们利用这支东拼西凑的舰队疯狂地劫掠恒星系内的贸易船。
texts.en: With its vulnerable and unprotected trade route, the [pirate_system.GetName] system has attracted a large number of ne'er-do-wells, and following a recent power struggle, these criminal degenerates are now sufficiently organized to operate a significant pirate armada. They are using this ragtag fleet to intercept as much trade in the system as they can.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附近恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the nearby star system appears here.

notes.zh: 该窗口也会由 subject.5 直接发出（overlord_subject_events.txt:269）。
notes.en: This window is also fired directly by subject.5 (overlord_subject_events.txt:269).

texts.zh: 看来这些向我们请求离开前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的老兵们不仅没有遵守我们的命令，还顶着我们的名头无恶不作。此时我们要是前去澄清告诉大家我们没能约束好手下，必将颜面尽失。
texts.en: It seems that the veterans who asked us for leave to go to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] have not only defied our orders, but they have also claimed it was done in our name. At this point it would be an embarrassment if we were to go in and tell everyone that we do not have our own people under control.

label.zh: 希望他们之后能洗心革面吧。
label.en: Let us hope they make a good impression then.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国首都所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire's capital world appears here.

texts.zh: 看来这些老兵违抗了我们的命令，并且还是出发前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]了。我们最新的汇报称，他们已经彻底抛弃所有隶属于我们的标志，开始了他们的海盗生涯。
texts.en: It seems that the veterans have defied our orders, and set off towards [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] after all. Our latest reports say they have left all signs of being affiliated with us behind, and started taking up a life of piracy.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国首都所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire's capital world appears here.

summary.text:
# 发大财的冒险 / Lucrative Adventures

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 宗主国每五年一次的随机脉冲 on_five_year_random_pulse_overlord（00_on_actions.txt:521-535）：无事200，11个事件链各10（subject.1、50、100、1001、1050、1100、2001、2050、2100、3001、3050）；每条链的隐藏派发事件检查冷却标志和条件。
  The overlord's five-year random pulse on_five_year_random_pulse_overlord (00_on_actions.txt:521-535): nothing 200, eleven chains at 10 each (subject.1, 50, 100, 1001, 1050, 1100, 2001, 2050, 2100, 3001, 3050); the hidden dispatcher of each chain checks cooldown flags and conditions.
- 派发 subject.1（本身可见）：宗主国非格式塔且冷却标志 cooldown_bulwark_event_chain_1_overlord 未设；拥有堡垒型（bulwark）专精附庸，或军国主义的专精附庸，非格式塔。
  subject.1 (itself visible): a non-gestalt overlord without the cooldown flag cooldown_bulwark_event_chain_1_overlord, with a non-gestalt Bulwark specialist subject (or a militarist specialist subject).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1「有利可图的冒险」（宗主）：老兵请求前往附庸首都。a 正式批准（获能量奖励）→ 30天后 3「来自宗主国的老兵」（附庸方），其选项a善加利用 → 15天后 10「良好关系」，b 送回 → 12「老兵归来」。b 放任（获能量奖励）→ 50%（和平主义/灵性者×1.25）同样走 3；50%（军国/唯物×1.25，且附庸需有首都系统以外的边境系统）15天后宗主国得 14「私掠冒险」，30天后附庸方得 subject.5（海盗袭扰，窗口为 pirate.50「发现海盗」）。c 拒绝 → 80% 无事；10% 16「违令——佣兵」并走 3；10% 18「违令——海盗」并触发 subject.5/pirate.50。
  1 "Lucrative Adventures" (overlord): veterans ask to travel to the capital of the subject. a formally grant leave (energy reward) -> 3 "Veterans from [overlord]" (subject side) after 30 days, whose option a uses them well -> 10 "Good Relations" after 15 days, b sends them back -> 12 "Veterans Returning". b let them do as they wish (energy reward) -> 50% (x1.25 for pacifist / spiritualist) the same 3; 50% (x1.25 for militarist / materialist, and the subject needs a border system beyond its capital) 14 "Privateering Adventures" for the overlord after 15 days and subject.5 (pirate trouble, window pirate.50 "Pirates Sighted!") for the subject after 30 days. c refuse -> 80% nothing; 10% 16 "Defying Orders - Mercenaries" plus 3; 10% 18 "Defying Orders - Pirates" plus subject.5 / pirate.50.
- 链上的事件成对发给宗主国和附庸国双方；窗口措辞随玩家扮演的一方而异。
  Events of a chain are sent in pairs to the overlord and the subject; window wording differs for the side the player is on.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- c 的结果按权重互斥；a 的两条后续互斥。
  The outcomes of c are exclusive by weight; the two follow-ups of a are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 私掠结果的概率受修正（星号标注）。
  Privateering odds are modified (starred in the compiled weights).

  Checked: dispatcher conditions, options and odds, the cross-story pirate.50 (a shared pirate event).
